note: 只跑候选形态、不改翻译器行为、不改白名单、不改判据；沙箱以 mode=ro 打开，源库零改动

forms.name: date_trunc_month
forms.note: DATE_TRUNC('month', x) 的候选等价形态（PG 返回月初零点）
forms.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-01', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS v FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3

forms.name: date_trunc_year
forms.note: DATE_TRUNC('year', x) 的候选等价形态
forms.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-01-01', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS v FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3

forms.name: date_trunc_day
forms.note: DATE_TRUNC('day', x) 的候选等价形态
forms.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS v FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3

forms.name: date_trunc_quarter_untouched
forms.note: PG 季度截断要落到季度首日，SQLite 无等价原语 ⇒ 不翻、原样保留并继续告警
forms.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS v FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3

forms.name: extract_year
forms.note: EXTRACT(YEAR FROM x) 的候选等价形态
forms.sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) AS v FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3

forms.name: extract_month
forms.note: EXTRACT(MONTH FROM x) 的候选等价形态
forms.sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) AS v FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3

forms.name: extract_day
forms.note: EXTRACT(DAY FROM x) 的候选等价形态
forms.sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%d', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) AS v FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3

forms.name: extract_quarter
forms.note: EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM x) 的候选等价形态（整数除法）
forms.sql: SELECT ((CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3) AS v FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3

forms.name: cast_timestamp_via_cast
forms.note: ⚠️ 陷阱：SQLite 的 TIMESTAMP 走 NUMERIC 亲和性，会把时间串截成数字
forms.sql: SELECT CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS v FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3

forms.name: strip_timestamp_cast
forms.note: x::timestamp 的候选等价形态（PG 侧是恒等 ⇒ 只剥掉运算符，不转 CAST）
forms.sql: SELECT o.order_purchase_timestamp AS v FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 3

cast_timestamp_trap.sql: SELECT CAST('2018-03-05 10:11:12' AS TIMESTAMP) AS v

rejected_without_running.name: cast_numeric_kept
rejected_without_running.note: x::numeric 改舍入语义（PG numeric 精确十进制 / SQLite REAL）⇒ 拒收，原样保留

rejected_without_running.name: cast_date_kept
rejected_without_running.note: x::date 会截掉时分 ⇒ 改结果粒度 ⇒ 拒收，原样保留

rejected_without_running.name: cast_text_kept
rejected_without_running.note: x::text 会改比较语义（数值列被当字符串比）⇒ 拒收，原样保留
